_note: Derived by tools/wind-climate.mjs (docs/wind-climate.md, SOURCE_NOTES WC1–WC9). Directions are where the wind blows from, degrees true. Hours are local standard time (LST); in daylight time the clock reads one hour later.

sources.raws: Oakland North RAWS (COKN), WRCC frequency tool raws.dri.edu/cgi-bin/wea_freq2.pl, hourly mean wind (10-minute mean at 20 ft), June 1992 to October 2026
sources.asos: Oakland International Airport ASOS (OAK), Iowa Environmental Mesonet cgi-bin/request/asos.py, routine hourly reports (2-minute mean at 10 m), 2008 to October 2026

oak._note: Per LST day: vector-mean direction of the afternoon (12–17), evening (18–23) and the next night (0–5), each from at least 3 reports with a mean vector of 2 mph or more. "Reverse" = turned 135° or more from the afternoon. Days counted only when the afternoon was onshore (180–315°).
